description: This file defines a PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_ValidatorAtom' that provides an interface for validating scalar member variables within a configuration schema. The class includes methods for asserting data types, nullity, alphanumeric content, emptiness, and lookup arrays, along with error handling capabilities.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ConfigSchema_ValidatorAtom
classes.description: A class providing validation methods for scalar configuration member variables in HTMLPurifier.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with context, object, member name, and links contents to the member variable.

methods.name: assertIsString
methods.description: Checks if the content is a string; throws an exception if not.

methods.name: assertIsBool
methods.description: Checks if the content is a boolean; throws an exception if not.

methods.name: assertIsArray
methods.description: Checks if the content is an array; throws an exception if not.

methods.name: assertNotNull
methods.description: Checks if the content is not null; throws an exception if null.

methods.name: assertAlnum
methods.description: Checks if the string content is alphanumeric; throws an exception if not.

methods.name: assertNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the content is not empty; throws an exception if empty.

methods.name: assertIsLookup
methods.description: Checks if the content is an array used as a lookup table, with all elements true; throws an exception if not.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Throws an exception with a specified message including context and member name.
